note: Roadmap to the platinum, built only from the official trophy descriptions: story chapters and missions, collectible counts, and the missable flags in trophies.json. Do the stages in order; the story stage first, the platinum last.

stages.detail: Play the main missions in order. Chapters 1 to 4, the named missions (Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission all unlock by finishing them. Do the missable choices trophy as you go: Actions Speak Louder tracks choices toward 500, and some choices cannot be revisited.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story — Chapters 1–4

stages.detail: Finish the stranger strands (8 of them), the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and the two partner trophies while your partner is still with you: Hot Together (lose a 4-star wanted level together) and Retail Therapy (rob 3 shops back-to-back). Beat Cal in a fishing challenge the first time it is offered. Also try one of each of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
stages.title: 2 · Side strands & partners

stages.detail: Sweep the map: meditate at all 18 spots, finish 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, buy all 8 garage properties and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. None of these is missable — they can all be done in free roam.
stages.title: 3 · Collectibles sweep

stages.detail: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 locations, win 20 different races, complete an arcade game, bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley, hunt the unique animal for Bret, and finish 50 challenges. Stunts (250) build up through all of this — keep driving aggressively.
stages.title: 4 · Activities & challenges

stages.detail: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and a jewelry store undetected; take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus; smash out of a vehicle showroom; bowl someone over with a melee drive-by; and rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
stages.title: 5 · Combat & heists

stages.detail: Launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 across all shops, and mop up the one-off moments: the unscheduled departure at VCIA, the cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, the partnership moment (Personal Best), a second-try success (Bad Luck, I Guess) and the strange event (The Truth Is Out There).
stages.title: 6 · Money, exploration & clean-up

stages.detail: Reach 100% completion — story, side missions, activities and collectibles all done — and the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, unlocks with it. Nothing extra to do. Check the tracker: every box ticked means the platinum is yours.
stages.title: 7 · 100% & Platinum
